conceptZh: 科學家老鼠滾出一顆紅豆，紅豆在畫面裡彈來彈去，每撞一下就掉下一筆，湊成「糸」加「工」，組成「紅」字。
object: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse, a bouncing glossy red bean, and test tubes that ring when hit
morph: a red bean ricochets around and each hit drops one stroke of 糸 and 工 into place to form 紅
creativeAngle: 連鎖彈跳：一顆紅豆在試管與燒杯之間彈來彈去，每次撞擊掉一筆，先「糸」再「工」，老鼠的眼鏡跟著追蹤紅豆。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and clear, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-mint backdrop with a few ringing glass test tubes standing at the bottom left and right. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated vermilion-red Traditional Chinese glyph 紅, the silk component 糸 on the left and the beam 工 on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat with round glasses and a curled tail; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the mouse holds up a beaker, tips it and a single glossy red bean rolls out; the first spoken 紅 lands as the bean pings off the rim of a test tube, which rings with a bright note, and drops the first red stroke, a small twist of thread curling in at the left. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the bean rockets across the frame, ricochets from a test tube to a beaker to the ceiling, and each hit drops another stroke, the second twist, then the lower flick and three tiny dots of the 糸 stacking into place at left, while the mouse's glasses swing left and right as he tracks it, his head spinning; the second spoken 紅 lands as the left half completes. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): the bean ricochets one last time off the mouse's tail, bounces off his round glasses, and thuds into the right side where two last strokes drop in as the horizontal bars and the upright of 工; the word 紅豆 is spoken as the bean rolls to the mouse's paws, and glows with a happy sparkle while the mouse catches it. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 紅 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in vermilion; the mouse sits at the side holding the shiny bean, hugging it with a tail wiggle and polishing his glasses, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「紅、紅、紅豆」, read as ㄏㄨㄥˊ、ㄏㄨㄥˊ、ㄏㄨㄥˊ ㄉㄡˋ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.8s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. No background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
